name: PageFly
summary: Shopify page builder with an AI page generator, drag-and-drop editor, 320+ templates, A/B testing and heatmaps; a free plan covers one published page, paid plans tier by page count.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want drag-and-drop landing, product and home pages plus A/B testing and heatmaps in one app, with a free plan to try first
skip_if: you only need a handful of sections inside your theme editor, you want one flat price whatever your page count, or you need a tool we have tested ourselves on a paid plan
honest_knock: The price depends on how many pages you publish, and the website and the App Store list different plan ladders (the website shows Optimize and Power, the listing shows Enterprise at $299). The free plan allows only one published page or section, and A/B testing starts on the $39 plan. We ran the free plan on a development store on 18 November 2026; the paid plans and the live-store result of the page are untested by us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Builder · per month for 5 published pages or sections and 80 AI credits, billed monthly
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on pagefly.io/pages/pricing and apps.shopify.com/pagefly, US dollars, billed monthly unless stated) Free: $0, 1 published page or section, 10 AI credits a month, 320+ templates, demo dashboard, no card. Builder: $24 a month for 5 pages or sections and 80 AI credits; the website says the price moves with a slot slider and the App Store lists $5 per 5 extra pages or sections. Optimize: $39 a month for 20 pages or sections, 140 AI credits, A/B testing, heatmaps on 10 pages, sales funnel. Accelerate: $99 a month or $990 a year, unlimited pages and sections, full CRO suite (A/B testing, heatmaps, AEO optimizer, cart drawer). Power: $199 a month or $1,990 a year (listed on the website only). Enterprise tiers for Shopify Plus and multi-store brands: Scale $299, Dominate $499, Empire $999 a month. 30-day money-back guarantee on the first payment of a paid plan, once per store.

schema_offer.description: Builder, per month for 5 published pages or sections and 80 AI credits, billed monthly; Free is $0 for 1 page or section; Optimize $39; Accelerate $99 a month or $990 a year; Power $199 a month or $1,990 a year. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

messages.subject: Building on a dev store? Two things worth knowing
You're all set: nothing more to pay for PageFly

measured.tested_by: Our team; actor, account and scope are documented in the review.
method: Installed from the Shopify App Store on our development store; a template page was built in the editor, saved and previewed, not published; the plan screens were read; nothing was paid or approved; the app was uninstalled after the test.

claims.observed: The listing gives Free 1 published slot (1 page or 1 section) and 10 AI credits per month. In our test (18 Nov 2026) the app pop-up showed Free with 1 page or section and 10 AI credits a month, store sets Free sets only, dashboard analytics Demo and AI page checkup No.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The Free line on the listing against the Free column of the pop-up in the app; the limit was not run into, because nothing was published.
claims.buying_consequence: The free plan lets you put one page or section live with 10 AI credits a month; for more you need a paid plan.

claims.observed: In our test (18 Nov 2026) the editor bar said 0 / 50 slots used while the account was on the free plan that promises 1 page. Nothing was published, so it is not known whether the app stops at 1 or at 50.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The editor counter against the plan limit of 1 page; no second page was made and nothing was published.
claims.buying_consequence: The counter in the editor does not tell you the real limit of the free plan; count on 1 page.

claims.observed: The listing shows Builder at $24 / month from 5 published pages or sections and from 80 AI credits per month. In our test (18 Nov 2026) the plan page showed Builder (Recommended) at $24 /month with 5 pages or sections and 80 AI credits a month.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The Builder price on the listing against the plan page in the app; Builder was not started.
claims.buying_consequence: Builder costs $24 a month for 5 pages or sections, on the listing and in the app.

claims.claim: Try Builder: $1 for your first month
claims.observed: In our test (18 Nov 2026) the button to continue on Free opened a pop-up offering Builder at $1 for the first month, then $24/month on the Shopify bill. The listing does not mention this offer. The offer was not accepted.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The pop-up in the app against a listing that names no first month offer; no approval screen was opened for it.
claims.buying_consequence: You may be offered Builder for $1 in the first month, but this offer is not on the listing and was not tried.

claims.observed: In our test (18 Nov 2026) the plan page showed Optimize at $39 /month with 20 pages or sections and 140 AI credits, A/B testing, heatmaps for 10 pages and an AEO optimizer. The listing of 18 Nov 2026 names no Optimize plan.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The Optimize column in the app against a listing without that plan; there is no listing price to compare it with.
claims.buying_consequence: There is a middle plan at $39 in the app that the listing does not show, so the listing is not the full price list.

claims.observed: The listing shows Accelerate at $99 / month or $990/year with unlimited published pages and 400 AI credits per month. In our test (18 Nov 2026) the plan page showed Accelerate at $99 /month with unlimited pages and 400 AI credits; the yearly price was not seen in the app.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The Accelerate price on the listing against the plan page in the app; the yearly option was not seen in the app.
claims.buying_consequence: Accelerate costs $99 a month for unlimited pages; a yearly price of $990 is on the listing only.

claims.observed: The listing shows Enterprise at $299 / month with 1,600 AI credits per month. The app showed no Enterprise plan in our test (18 Nov 2026).
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The Enterprise line on the listing against a plan page in the app that does not show it.
claims.buying_consequence: Enterprise is on the listing only; how to get it from inside the app was not seen.

claims.observed: The listing names AI Page Checkup under Accelerate. In our test (18 Nov 2026) the app listed AI page checkup for Builder, Optimize and Accelerate and the pop-up said Yes for Builder and No for Free. The feature was not tried.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The feature lists on the listing and in the app against each other; neither plan was started.
claims.buying_consequence: Whether AI Page Checkup comes with Builder or only with Accelerate depends on whether you read the app or the listing.

claims.claim: A short setup first. About 3 minutes.
claims.observed: The onboarding promised about 3 minutes. The template page was open in the editor at 13:10:41, about 1.5 minutes after Install was confirmed and 2 minutes after the start, after 8 to 9 clicks.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: AI-assisted browser test includes pauses and waiting for us; record screens and prerequisites, not human time-to-value.
claims.buying_consequence: You can have a first page from a template in the editor within a few minutes of installing.

claims.observed: The template route said No AI credits needed and the Coming soon template opened without any credit prompt. The credit balance was not read before and after, so the use of credits was not measured.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The label on the template route against a credit balance that was not read.
claims.buying_consequence: Building from a template looks free of credits, which matters on a free plan with 10 credits.

claims.claim: Once saved, the page will be ready for preview.
claims.observed: Preview before saving gave Not found on the store. After Save the Preview showed the page inside the theme header and footer with heading, text and e-mail field, but the countdown was empty and the editor bar still said Untitled.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The text of the save dialog against the Preview before and after saving; the page was not published.
claims.buying_consequence: You have to save before you can preview, and the preview may not show every element of the template.

claims.claim: The PageFly app embed is switched off in your current theme, so your pages will not show on your storefront.
claims.observed: The editor showed this bar after the template was opened. The app embed was not switched on and the page was not published, so the page was never seen on the live storefront.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The warning in the editor against a theme that was left unchanged; publishing was left out on purpose.
claims.buying_consequence: Before a PageFly page is visible to shoppers you have to switch on the app embed in your theme, which changes the theme and was not done here.

claims.observed: No Shopify approval screen was reached: Continue on Free was chosen in the pop-up, so no total, tax, term or payment step was seen for any plan.
claims.plan: Free plan only; the plan page and the $1 pop-up were read, no plan was started
claims.comparability: The prices on the plan page and the pop-up against a Shopify approval screen that never appeared; no tax line, term or stored cost rule was compared.
claims.buying_consequence: No price you would pay was seen on a Shopify approval screen, so only the plan page and the pop-up are confirmed.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested PageFly (PageFly AI Page Builder) on a Shopify development store: the install without a separate account, a short setup, a Coming soon page from a template in the editor about 1.5 minutes after the install, saved and previewed on the store but not published, the yellow bar that the app embed is off in the theme, the plan page with Builder, Optimize and Accelerate, a pop-up offering Builder for $1 in the first month, and the uninstall dialog, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or published. Install: the App Store listing was opened at 13:08 and the install form was sent in our own tab. Shopify showed its Install app screen with three data blocks (customer data, staff data and store data) and Install was confirmed at about 13:09. No separate PageFly account, e-mail address or password was asked. The onboarding said A short setup first. About 3 minutes. It had a box to accept all cookies, which was left off, and it said that the app embed has to be switched on in the theme before pages can show on the storefront. After Next the app asked how to build the first page: Build with AI in PageFly (Free plan: 10 AI credits, 1 page or section) or Browse templates (No AI credits needed), plus rebuilding pages from the current site and importing PageFly pages. Core action: Browse templates, the Templates tab (135 templates) and the Pixel Coming soon template, without AI credits. The page was open in the PageFly editor at 13:10:41, about 1.5 minutes after Install was confirmed and 2 minutes after the start, after 8 to 9 clicks. The editor showed Page content, a Flex section, 0 / 50 slots used and a yellow bar Enable PageFly in your theme, which said the app embed is switched off in the current theme, so the pages will not show on the storefront. The template has the heading WE ARE COMING SOON, a countdown (Days, Hours, Mins, Secs) and an e-mail field with Submit. Preview before saving opened the store address of the PageFly preview and gave Not found. After Save (a dialog with a Page title field that says the page will be ready for preview once saved and must be published to go live) the Preview showed the page on the store inside the theme header and footer: heading, text and e-mail field were there, but the countdown was empty. The title stayed Untitled in the editor bar although the title Coming soon test was typed. The page was saved but NOT published; the theme was not changed and the app embed was not switched on. Plans in our test (18 Nov 2026): after the template the app showed a plan page that says Free gets your first page live and Builder lets you launch 5 with 80 AI credits, dashboard analytics and AI page checkup. Builder (Recommended) $24 /month, 5 pages or sections, 80 AI credits a month; Optimize $39 /month, 20 pages or sections and 140 AI credits, with A/B testing, heatmaps for 10 pages and an AEO optimizer; Accelerate $99 /month, unlimited pages and 400 AI credits, heatmaps for 50 pages. The button to continue on Free opened a pop-up Try Builder: $1 for your first month (Free 1 page and 10 AI credits against Builder 5 and 80), then $24/month on the Shopify bill. Continue on Free was chosen; no Shopify approval screen came up, nothing was approved and no card or payment method was seen. Listing: The live App Store listing apps.shopify.com/pagefly, read again on 18 Nov 2026 just before this delivery, is titled PageFly AI Page Builder (with a star sign between the words), has the label Free plan available and a rating of 4.9 from 5,924 reviews. It lists Free (1 published slot, 1 page or 1 section, 10 AI credits per month), Builder at $24 / month (from 5 published pages or sections, from 80 AI credits per month, with $5 per 5 extra pages or sections as an option), Accelerate at $99 / month or $990/year (unlimited published pages and sections, 400 AI credits per month, with AI Page Checkup) and Enterprise at $299 / month (1,600 AI credits per month). The listing names no Optimize plan and no $1 first month. So the listing confirms Free, Builder at $24 and Accelerate at $99. Optimize at $39 and the $1 first month were seen only in the app, in our test (18 Nov 2026). Enterprise, the yearly price and the extra slots were seen only on the listing. The listing names AI Page Checkup under Accelerate, while the app lists it for Builder. The editor counter 0 / 50 slots used on the free plan does not match the 1 page that Free promises. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so there was nothing to cancel. Plan and app both end through Settings, Apps, the PageFly row, the menu and Uninstall. The dialog says the app can no longer be used, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A reason is required before Uninstall becomes active; feedback is optional. Not tested: the paid plans (Builder, Optimize, Accelerate), the $1 first month, A/B testing, heatmaps, AI Page Checkup, building a page with AI credits (FlyMate), store sets, theme sections, the MCP connector, publishing to the live store, switching on the app embed and whether the countdown works once the embed is on. Clean up: our preview tab and the admin tab were closed. The app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps with the reason Testing multiple apps and Shopify confirmed the uninstall. The saved, unpublished page goes with the app data. No theme change was saved, no product was made and other apps were not touched. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A page made in PageFly does not show on the storefront until you switch on the app embed in your theme, and the Preview only works after Save. The countdown of the template was empty in the preview. The title we typed did not show in the editor bar, which kept saying Untitled. The editor said 0 / 50 slots used on a free plan that promises 1 page. The plans in the app and on the listing differ: the app shows Optimize at $39 and a $1 first month for Builder, the listing shows neither but names Enterprise at $299 and a yearly price for Accelerate.

The paid plans (Builder, Optimize, Accelerate) and the $1 first month.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested PageFly (PageFly AI Page Builder) on a Shopify development store: the install without a separate account, a short setup, a Coming soon page from a template in the editor about 1.5 minutes after the install, saved and previewed on the store but not published, the yellow bar that the app embed is off in the theme, the plan page with Builder, Optimize and Accelerate, a pop-up offering Builder for $1 in the first month, and the uninstall dialog, which asks for a reason. Nothing was paid, approved or published. Install: the App Store listing was opened at 13:08 and the install form was sent in our own tab. Shopify showed its Install app screen with three data blocks (customer data, staff data and store data) and Install was confirmed at about 13:09. No separate PageFly account, e-mail address or password was asked. The onboarding said A short setup first. About 3 minutes. It had a box to accept all cookies, which was left off, and it said that the app embed has to be switched on in the theme before pages can show on the storefront. After Next the app asked how to build the first page: Build with AI in PageFly (Free plan: 10 AI credits, 1 page or section) or Browse templates (No AI credits needed), plus rebuilding pages from the current site and importing PageFly pages. Core action: Browse templates, the Templates tab (135 templates) and the Pixel Coming soon template, without AI credits. The page was open in the PageFly editor at 13:10:41, about 1.5 minutes after Install was confirmed and 2 minutes after the start, after 8 to 9 clicks. The editor showed Page content, a Flex section, 0 / 50 slots used and a yellow bar Enable PageFly in your theme, which said the app embed is switched off in the current theme, so the pages will not show on the storefront. The template has the heading WE ARE COMING SOON, a countdown (Days, Hours, Mins, Secs) and an e-mail field with Submit. Preview before saving opened the store address of the PageFly preview and gave Not found. After Save (a dialog with a Page title field that says the page will be ready for preview once saved and must be published to go live) the Preview showed the page on the store inside the theme header and footer: heading, text and e-mail field were there, but the countdown was empty. The title stayed Untitled in the editor bar although the title Coming soon test was typed. The page was saved but NOT published; the theme was not changed and the app embed was not switched on. Plans in our test (18 Nov 2026): after the template the app showed a plan page that says Free gets your first page live and Builder lets you launch 5 with 80 AI credits, dashboard analytics and AI page checkup. Builder (Recommended) $24 /month, 5 pages or sections, 80 AI credits a month; Optimize $39 /month, 20 pages or sections and 140 AI credits, with A/B testing, heatmaps for 10 pages and an AEO optimizer; Accelerate $99 /month, unlimited pages and 400 AI credits, heatmaps for 50 pages. The button to continue on Free opened a pop-up Try Builder: $1 for your first month (Free 1 page and 10 AI credits against Builder 5 and 80), then $24/month on the Shopify bill. Continue on Free was chosen; no Shopify approval screen came up, nothing was approved and no card or payment method was seen. Listing: The live App Store listing apps.shopify.com/pagefly, read again on 18 Nov 2026 just before this delivery, is titled PageFly AI Page Builder (with a star sign between the words), has the label Free plan available and a rating of 4.9 from 5,924 reviews. It lists Free (1 published slot, 1 page or 1 section, 10 AI credits per month), Builder at $24 / month (from 5 published pages or sections, from 80 AI credits per month, with $5 per 5 extra pages or sections as an option), Accelerate at $99 / month or $990/year (unlimited published pages and sections, 400 AI credits per month, with AI Page Checkup) and Enterprise at $299 / month (1,600 AI credits per month). The listing names no Optimize plan and no $1 first month. So the listing confirms Free, Builder at $24 and Accelerate at $99. Optimize at $39 and the $1 first month were seen only in the app, in our test (18 Nov 2026). Enterprise, the yearly price and the extra slots were seen only on the listing. The listing names AI Page Checkup under Accelerate, while the app lists it for Builder. The editor counter 0 / 50 slots used on the free plan does not match the 1 page that Free promises. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so there was nothing to cancel. Plan and app both end through Settings, Apps, the PageFly row, the menu and Uninstall. The dialog says the app can no longer be used, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A reason is required before Uninstall becomes active; feedback is optional. Not tested: the paid plans (Builder, Optimize, Accelerate), the $1 first month, A/B testing, heatmaps, AI Page Checkup, building a page with AI credits (FlyMate), store sets, theme sections, the MCP connector, publishing to the live store, switching on the app embed and whether the countdown works once the embed is on. Clean up: our preview tab and the admin tab were closed. The app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps with the reason Testing multiple apps and Shopify confirmed the uninstall. The saved, unpublished page goes with the app data. No theme change was saved, no product was made and other apps were not touched. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A page made in PageFly does not show on the storefront until you switch on the app embed in your theme, and the Preview only works after Save. The countdown of the template was empty in the preview. The title we typed did not show in the editor bar, which kept saying Untitled. The editor said 0 / 50 slots used on a free plan that promises 1 page. The plans in the app and on the listing differ: the app shows Optimize at $39 and a $1 first month for Builder, the listing shows neither but names Enterprise at $299 and a yearly price for Accelerate.
